const r1 = await tools.progress.append_progress({
  content: `STAGE: evidence-grounded ranking of 5 proposals (rubric rank-2026-10-v1, one candidate / one run, no ablation arms).
READ: the five frozen bundles (422ac3c7 GROMOVSWAP-L1-RQ, 7a105a8c HEXSWAP-SID, 1a570bc7 HYP-CERT-LEAFREPAIR, d3e91cc5 ADM-GEO-RQ, b97d402a TAUSWAP-POINCARE-EXCHANGE). All five bundles repeat the SAME observed diagnostics E4-E11, so the decisive evidence is shared: E6 width-20 beam survival and E7 teacher-forced per-position NLL.
KEY OBSERVATIONS:
 - E6 (l1_br baseline): recall@10 0.04671; gold prefix alive at depths 1/2/3/4 = 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068. Level-1 prefix is NEVER the bottleneck (1.000), and the prefix dies only at depth 4 (0.068).
 - E7 (l1_br): T1/T2/T3/T4 NLL = 0.00/0.00/0.00/9.03. The entire predictive loss is the deepest token. Prefix tokens are already perfectly predictable.
 - E6 alternatives: l1_br_euclid 0.06207 and resample 0.06363 both carry depth-4 survival 0.085-0.088, i.e. the ceiling tracks depth-4 survival, not depth-1.
 - E8: K=256 first-level co-clustering of positive pairs is only 0.0822 (neg 0.0129); small K (16/32) keeps neighbours together far more, i.e. the level-1 capacity ceiling argument is real but level-1 survival is already saturated at 1.000, so it cannot be the lever.
 - E5/E9/E10/E11: the transition signal itself is strong and non-degenerate (top-1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543; cohort agreement 0.9291 vs 0.8871; mean out-degree 5.45; same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067). So a behaviour graph is usable by all five; the differentiator is WHERE it is applied.
INFERENCE: proposals that mutate only level 1 (GROMOVSWAP-L1-RQ, HEXSWAP-SID, TAUSWAP-POINCARE-EXCHANGE) target a coordinate whose beam survival is already 1.000, and they leave the T4 NLL=9.03 untouched -> low expected effect on test_recall@10 and a structural mismatch with the measured failure. Proposals that reach the deepest token (HYP-CERT-LEAFREPAIR: leaf only, prefixes bit-identical; ADM-GEO-RQ: admission at every level incl. the last, in-loop) are aligned with E6/E7.
TIE-BREAKS: HYP-CERT-LEAFREPAIR over ADM-GEO-RQ because (a) it acts exactly on the measured T4 bottleneck, (b) frozen prefixes mean it cannot damage the already-perfect 1.000/0.829 depth-1/2 survival, (c) curvature does real work (Poincare distance from a behaviour-displaced gyromidpoint, scale derived as 7.6 = artanh(1-1e-3), bound B=ln((1-r0)/r0) measured), whereas ADM-GEO-RQ keeps K=1 with an exp-map scale rho_l that the authors themselves concede is near-linear for small residuals (geometry-off ~ both-on) and its dX<=0 veto is trivially satisfied by staying put (self-declared inertness risk).
AMONG THE THREE LEVEL-1 IDEAS: TAUSWAP 3rd (post-hoc single pass, cardinality-preserving exchange so cell-size multiset is invariant and the L1 diagnostic is attributable, exact integer Delta-D/Delta-R predicate, cost under 5 min) > GROMOVSWAP 4th (guard runs for 2700 of 3000 epochs but swapped items are 'released' after one epoch so the encoder re-claims them: churn is largely undone, net effect ~ one epoch's swaps, at 3-8% wall clock and real reconstruction-damage risk to the level-1 codebook) > HEXSWAP 5th (move set exists only where the Lorentz nearest codeword disagrees with the frozen Euclidean assignment, a set its own kill-rule anticipates may be empty; K=1/(4 delta_hat^2) derived from a sampled delta estimate is unbounded/highly unstable, so saturating Lorentz distances can make the admissibility tau unreachable).
OPEN: no ablation arms are run, so the ranking is a prior on expected single-run effect, not a measurement.`,
});
return r1;

input.content:
FINAL ANSWER (rank-2026-10-v1, all five placed, no ties, no gaps):
RANK: HYP-CERT-LEAFREPAIR | position=1 | reason=E6/E7 put the failure at the deepest token (gold prefix alive depth 1/2/3 = 1.000/1.000/1.000 but depth 4 = 0.068; NLL 0.00/0.00/0.00/9.03), and this is the only proposal that moves the last code with prefixes bit-identical (so the already-perfect depth-1/2 survival cannot regress) while curvature does real work as the Poincare distance from a behaviour-displaced gyromidpoint with a measured bound B=ln((1-r0)/r0) and derived scale 7.6.
RANK: ADM-GEO-RQ | position=2 | reason=It is the only in-loop candidate whose admission operates at every level including the level that carries the whole 9.03 T4 NLL, and E6 shows assignment-level interference is consequential (l1_br_euclid 0.06207 vs baseline l1_br 0.04671), but it is placed second because fixed K=1 with a measured rho_l exp-map scale is conceded to be near-linear on small residuals (geometry-off ~ both-on) and its dX<=0 veto is satisfied trivially by not moving.
RANK: TAUSWAP-POINCARE-EXCHANGE | position=3 | reason=Best of the three level-1 repairs: one post-hoc pass with zero Stage-2 cost, exact integer Delta-D/Delta-R admissibility and a one-for-one exchange that conserves the cell-size multiset, so its 0.0907-vs-0.067 same-first-prefix diagnostic (E11) is attributable; still demoted because E6 shows depth-1 survival is already 1.000, so the lever it can move is not the measured bottleneck, and it risks near-origin Euclidean-equivalence.
RANK: GROMOVSWAP-L1-RQ | position=4 | reason=Level-1-only against a 1.000 depth-1 survival, and its per-epoch guard is self-defeating: swapped items are released after one epoch so the unchanged Euclidean residual argmin re-claims them, leaving roughly one epoch of net swaps after 3000 epochs while paying 3-8% wall clock and risking the level-1 codebook via the reconstruction damage listed as its own risk (b); the measured delta_hat certificate only gates, it does not steer.
RANK: HEXSWAP-SID | position=5 | reason=Placed last on the evidence because both of its gating quantities are the least grounded: the move set exists only where the Lorentz nearest codeword disagrees with the frozen Euclidean assignment (its own kill rule anticipates fewer than 100 such items, i.e. a no-op), and K=1/(4 delta_hat^2) is extrapolated from a sampled four-point delta with no bound, so saturating Lorentz distances can make its (1-h1) quantile bound tau unreachable; it shares the level-1 misdirection of position 3-4 with the weakest admissibility.
